Quest.summary: The Brass Sextant went missing somewhere in The Drowned Warren. Find it and bring it back.
Quest.title: Recover the Brass Sextant

Quest.summary: No one has a true map of Mistwood. Walk every room of it and come back.
Quest.title: Chart Mistwood

Quest.summary: There are too many Wild Boars about, worst of all around Driftwood Weald. Defeat 5 of them, wherever you find them.
Quest.title: Thin out the Wild Boars

Quest.summary: The Saint's Reliquary went missing somewhere in The Drowned Warren. Find it and bring it back.
Quest.title: Recover the Saint's Reliquary

Quest.summary: No one has a true map of Driftwood Weald. Walk every room of it and come back.
Quest.title: A map of Driftwood Weald

Quest.summary: Fishers won't go out while Shore Crabs are this bold. Defeat 4; The Drowned Warren is thick with them.
Quest.title: Too many Shore Crabs

Quest.summary: The harbour pays well for the Grizzled Shore Crab that haunts The Brine Halls. Bring word it's done.
Quest.title: Wanted: the Grizzled Shore Crab

Quest.summary: The Harbourmaster's Ledger went missing somewhere in Hagsmoor Copse. Find it and bring it back.
Quest.title: Recover the Harbourmaster's Ledger

Enemy.description: A crab the size of a cartwheel, shell scabbed with barnacles. It sidles toward you, claws raised.
Enemy.name: Grizzled Shore Crab

QuestItem.description: Green with verdigris, its mirror cracked, its arc still true.
QuestItem.name: Brass Sextant

QuestItem.description: A little tin box with a knucklebone inside, wrapped in faded silk.
QuestItem.name: Saint's Reliquary

QuestItem.description: Its pages are stuck together with salt, but the figures are legible.
QuestItem.name: Harbourmaster's Ledger

Clue.text: Scratched into a wall with a knife point: a warning, a name, and a promise of payment.
A letter, never sent: "I hid the Harbourmaster's Ledger in Hagsmoor Copse. Whoever finds this, take it to the harbour."

log: You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade.
The Tavern has beds for 4 gold a night.
You take down the notice: Recover the Brass Sextant.
You buy the Miner's Helm from the Smithy for 10 gold.
You sell the Miner's Helm to the Smithy for 3 gold.
A bed costs 4 gold; you have 3.
A cart rattles past and away down the road.

rooms.description: Where the heath gives out, the pines begin: a dark wall leaning away from the sea wind.
features: A ribbon tied to a branch, faded to no colour at all.
rooms.name: The Forest Edge

ambient: Something moves in the bracken and is still.
Needles patter down.
rooms.description: The path narrows between banks of fern taller than you are.
rooms.name: Dripping Path

ambient: The stream talks to itself.
rooms.description: A brown stream chatters over stones on its way to the sea.
features: A little dam of sticks, too neat to be the water's doing.
rooms.name: Misty Stream

ambient: Something moves in the bracken and is still.

rooms.description: A deer path winds between the trunks, soft with needles.
rooms.name: Dim Path

ambient: A bird starts to sing, then stops.
rooms.description: A sunlit glade, strangely quiet, as if the forest is holding its breath.
features: A ring of toadstools, perfectly round.
rooms.name: Tangled Glade

ambient: Wood creaks somewhere overhead.
rooms.description: A tangle of fallen trunks you must climb over and under.
rooms.name: Dim Deadfall

ambient: Surf booms behind you.
Gulls wheel overhead and will not follow you in.
rooms.description: A ragged opening in the cliff, half-drowned at high tide. Cold air breathes out of it, smelling of salt and old stone.
rooms.name: The Cave Mouth

ambient: Wind sighs between the pillars.

features: Tide-lines on the pillars, far above your head.
rooms.name: Bone-White Gallery

ambient: The pool shivers, though nothing touched it.
rooms.description: A still pool fills most of the chamber, its surface flat as glass.

ambient: Wind sighs between the pillars.

rooms.description: A small, dry chamber with a flat stone like an altar at its centre.
rooms.name: Moonlit Shrine

ambient: Somewhere, something gnaws.
rooms.description: A ledge heaped with the bones of fish and seabirds, picked clean.
rooms.name: Sunken Bone Shelf

ambient: A drop of water lands on your neck.
The glow pulses, very slowly.
rooms.description: A grotto lit by a faint green glow from algae on the ceiling.
features: A ring of pebbles, carefully arranged, around nothing at all.
rooms.name: Hollow Grotto

ambient: Your footsteps come back to you a moment late.
rooms.description: A crack in the rock just wide enough to pass, its walls slick with weed.
